newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $105/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady at $105/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady, USDA said. Buyer inquiry decent. Seller interest somewhat limited as the bulk of this week's showlists already traded.
Wk To Date- 98,500 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 78,000 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 73,200

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1300 lbs - load 65.00; dressed basis 104.00, instances 105.00, load 103.50. ( weighted average 104.15). Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1225 lbs - couple loads 64.00; dressed basis 104.00, few 105.00, couple loads 103.00. ( weighted average 104.01 )
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
For the week - Slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis mostly 2.00 higher; dressed basis mostly 3.00 higher. This week's total includes 12,200 previously contracted or formulated cattle.
